meta.prompt: Let me book a table at Osteria Lume as an inline card: pick one of the next seven days (Sat 14, Sun 15, Mon 16, Tue 17, Wed 18, Thu 19, Fri 20), a party size from 1 to 8 (starting at 2), then a time slot: 17:30, 18:00, 18:30, 19:00, 19:30, 20:00, 20:30 or 21:00. Some are full and cannot be picked: on Sat 14 the 18:00 and 20:00 slots; on Sun 15 the 17:30 and 19:00 slots; on every day, for parties of 5 or more, 20:30 and 21:00 too. A confirm button, and once I confirm the card says "Table booked" with one line giving the day, the party size and the time.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Book a table" "Osteria Lume" icon:"restaurant_rounded" status:"Open"
  state day="Sat 14"
  state party=2
  state time=""
  state done=false
  if !done
    SectionLabel "Day" "next 7 days"
    DayPicker =day days:["Sat 14","Sun 15","Mon 16","Tue 17","Wed 18","Thu 19","Fri 20"]
    SectionLabel "Party size" "1 to 8"
    Counter "Guests" =party min:1 max:8 step:1
    SectionLabel "Time" "pick a slot"
    ChoiceChips =time columns:4 options:["17:30","18:00","18:30","19:00","19:30","20:00","20:30","21:00"] disabled:{day == "Sat 14" ? (party >= 5 ? ["18:00","20:00","20:30","21:00"] : ["18:00","20:00"]) : day == "Sun 15" ? (party >= 5 ? ["17:30","19:00","20:30","21:00"] : ["17:30","19:00"]) : (party >= 5 ? ["20:30","21:00"] : [])}
    ActionButton "Confirm booking" primary icon:"check_rounded" enabled:{time != ""} -> done=true
  if done
    Receipt "Table booked" "{day} for {party} at {time}" tone:good icon:"check_rounded"
